Note: this file uses literal escape sequences as placeholders since binary control chars are unsafe in many editors. The actual fixture loader interprets the placeholders.

C0 controls (must not render visible glyphs):
- BEL: <\x07>
- BS:  <\x08>
- TAB: <\x09>  (special — advance to next stop)
- LF:  <\x0a>  (newline — handled by VT)
- VT:  <\x0b>
- FF:  <\x0c>
- CR:  <\x0d>  (handled by VT)

C1 controls (sometimes used for OSC/CSI introducers — must not render):
- IND: <\x84>
- NEL: <\x85>
- HTS: <\x88>
- CSI: <\x9b>
- ST:  <\x9c>
- OSC: <\x9d>

DEL: <\x7f>
NUL: <\x00>  — embedded NUL must not crash atlas

Loader note: `scripts/expand-control-fixtures.py` substitutes the <\xNN> placeholders with actual bytes when feeding to the engine. Avoids editor confusion.
